name: backend
description: 1. **Controllers/**: API route handlers (e.g., `JobOrderController.cs`, `ContainerController.cs`)    - Handles HTTP POST/GET/PATCH, JWT authentication, and request validation. 2. **Services/**: Pure forwarder business logic (e.g., `JobOrderService.cs`, `PanvayaService.cs`)    - Validates tare/gross container weights, checks carrier cut-off dates, calculates Buy/Sell profit margins. 3. **Repositories/**: High-speed PostgreSQL data access (e.g., `JobOrderRepository.cs`)    - Manages atomic ACID transactions (`BEGIN ... COMMIT`) using Npgsql. 4. **Models/**: Strongly-typed entity definitions matching the PostgreSQL schema.
